items.date_raw: September 26, 2024, effective the date the Order in Council was approved
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 1271/2024; Government of Ontario, Stevenson Memorial Hospital Investigation Report
items.verbatim_snippet: On the recommendation of the Minister of Health, the Lieutenant Governor in Council appointed Eric Hanna as Supervisor for Stevenson Memorial Hospital under subsection 9(1) of the Public Hospitals Act.

items.date_raw: revoked effective at the end of June 8, 2025
items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 767/2025
items.verbatim_snippet: Hanna’s appointment continued until June 8, 2025, when it was revoked because he wished to step down and the government appointed a successor.

items.citation_text: Government of Ontario, Order in Council 767/2025; Interim Report, Supervisor, Stevenson Memorial Hospital, Carmine Stumpo, January 2026
items.verbatim_snippet: Order in Council 767/2025 revoked Hanna’s appointment at the end of June 8, 2025 and appointed Carmine Stumpo as his successor, effective June 9, 2025.
